categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Yike Food Group Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the poultry industry, encompassing two main integrated chains for broiler chickens and meat ducks. Its business segments include poultry slaughtering and processing, feed production and sales, commercial poultry seedling incubation and sales, and production and sales of prepared foods and cooked products. The company also engages in down processing such as pet food raw materials and feather processing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes integrated industrial chain management combining feed processing, breeding of parent stock, commercial poultry incubation, slaughtering, and deep processing of prepared and cooked products. It emphasizes automation upgrades in slaughtering lines and digital transformation initiatives, including R&D centers focusing on genetics, animal nutrition, health, food and equipment development. The company also applies scientific feed formulation and advanced breeding techniques to improve production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large-scale meat product processors, catering enterprises, supermarkets, and individual consumers. The company serves both B2B and B2C markets, with products distributed across restaurant chains, retail supermarkets, e-commerce platforms, and direct sales. Its products cater to traditional poultry meat consumption as well as emerging markets such as prepared dishes, hot pot ingredients, and pet food raw materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s production bases are mainly located in Jiangsu, Shandong, Hebei, and Guangdong provinces, with an office center in Shanghai. Its market coverage spans most regions of China, with significant sales in the East China, Central China, South China, North China, Southwest, Northeast, and Northwest regions. The company also has strategic plans for brand expansion including overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Yike Food Group operates across the entire poultry supply chain, from upstream feed production and breeding of parent stock, through midstream commercial poultry incubation and farming, to downstream slaughtering, processing, and sales of fresh and prepared poultry products. This full-chain integration allows for quality control, risk mitigation, and operational efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include deepening the integrated six-in-one industrial chain model centered on breeding, enhancing product quality management systems, and driving technological innovation in breeding and farming techniques. It invests in R&D for new product development, feed formulation, production automation, digital systems, and environmental sustainability. The company also focuses on brand building, organizational process optimization, talent development, and digital transformation of the entire supply chain.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of poultry products including fresh and frozen chicken and duck meat, feed products, commercial poultry seedlings, prepared foods, and cooked products. Sales channels include direct sales to large customers, distribution through dealers and supermarkets, e-commerce, and franchise operations. The company also earns rental income from investment properties and packaging services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Yike Food Group is positioned as a leading large-scale integrated poultry enterprise in China, ranking among the industry’s top players in both broiler chicken and meat duck chains. It competes with other major poultry producers and processors in China, leveraging its scale, integrated supply chain, technological innovation, and brand recognition to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 20.84 billion, a slight decrease of 4.8% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 100 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in 2023. The company’s total assets reached about RMB 4.82 billion, with steady growth in production capacity and cash flow from operations. It maintains a stable financial position with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, safe, and healthy poultry products with nutritional advantages such as high protein and low fat. Its integrated supply chain ensures product quality and food safety from feed to finished products. The company differentiates itself through technological innovation, diversified product offerings including prepared and cooked foods, strong brand presence, and responsiveness to evolving consumer preferences for convenience and health.
